decisions.decision: John's proposal to consider at a future meeting issues with potential consequences on future Town budgets was accepted, to be placed on a subsequent agenda after the Town budget process is done.
decisions.quote: mark said we could put this on a subsequent agenda after the town budget process is done.

decisions.decision: Next meeting set for Thursday, February 25, at which the Department of Public Works and the Land Use will give presentations on FY17 budgets.
decisions.quote: the department of public works and the land use will give presentations on fy17 budgets

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The police FY17 recommended budget is stated as a dollar amount and percentage over the FY16 recap; the budget is essentially level funded.
budget_items.quote: the fy17 recommended budget is $31,000, or 2.2% higher than the fy16 recap.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No funding was provided for the additional officers the police chief requested.
budget_items.quote: there is no funding for additional officers which chief marino has requested.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A records retention room was a capital projects request that was not approved for FY17.
budget_items.quote: the department needs a records retention room that was a capital projects request, but was not approved for fy17.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Narcan prices are rising and may strain future police budgets; funds for Narcan are currently built into the police budget.
budget_items.quote: narcan has become so common that the price is starting to creep up.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The fire FY17 recommended budget is stated as a dollar amount and percentage over FY16 recap.
budget_items.quote: the fy17 recommended budget is $23,700, or 3.1% higher than fy16 recap.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ambulance fees are returned to the general fund.
budget_items.quote: note: the $282,000 in ambulance fees goes back to the general fund.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: EMS supplies typically exceed the budgeted level and would be paid for by shifting funding from other line items if funds are available.
budget_items.quote: ems supplies typically exceed the budgeted level and would be paid for by shifting

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mandated training is not funded in the fire budget, risking retention of call staff who must train on their own time.
budget_items.quote: because mandated training is not funded in this budget, this risks retention of call staff

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The only bid to provide school busing for FY17 came from the current provider and would be an increase of $40,000; the service is mandated.
budget_items.quote: the only bid to provide busing for the schools for fy17 was from the current provide and it would be an increase of $40,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Library trustees are concerned about an increase in CW Mars fees because the state is not funding them at prior levels, so member libraries must make up the difference.
budget_items.quote: the board of trustees have some concern over the increase in cw mars fees.
